You've tried workarounds, but they're fragile and unreliable. You want a robust, free infrastructure that accepts crypto payments and gives you full control over your digital store. In this guide, we'll show you how to deploy a digital store on Cloudflare Pages for free, without relying on Stripe or any other platform.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The traditional digital store setup relies on platforms that can restrict or shut down your business at any time. They charge high fees, hold your money, and impose complex rules. In contrast, our infrastructure uses free tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, and NOWPayments, which provide a sovereign and decentralized setup that's immune to platform failures. By deploying your store on Cloudflare Pages, you can avoid the risks associated with relying on third-party platforms and maintain full control over your business.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you start deploying your digital store, you'll need to set up a few basic tools. First, create a GitHub account and set up a new repository for your store. Next, install the Cloudflare Pages CLI on your computer and set up a new project. Finally, create a NOWPayments account and obtain your API key. With these tools in place, you'll be ready to deploy your store on Cloudflare Pages.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once you have your basic tools set up, it's time to configure your payment and delivery pipeline. Use the NOWPayments API to integrate crypto payment processing with your store. Set up a Cloudflare Worker to handle orders and trigger the delivery of your digital products. With this setup, you'll be able to accept crypto payments and deliver your products to customers seamlessly.
Deploying your store on Cloudflare Pages provides a sovereign and decentralized setup that's immune to platform failures.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

After setting up your payment and delivery pipeline, it's time to go live and process your first transaction. Use the Cloudflare Pages CLI to deploy your store and make it accessible to the public. Test your payment processing setup by making a test purchase. Once you're confident that everything is working correctly, you can start selling your digital products and earning revenue.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your business grows, you may need to scale your infrastructure to handle increased traffic and sales. Use the Cloudflare Pages dashboard to monitor your store's performance and adjust your configuration as needed. Consider upgrading to the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for enhanced features and support. With this setup, you'll be able to scale your business without worrying about platform restrictions or fees.

Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages? Yes, you can host a digital product store on either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages using our sovereign infrastructure setup. Both platforms provide free hosting and a customizable setup that allows you to deploy your store quickly and easily. Use the Cloudflare Pages CLI to set up your store and configure your payment processing pipeline using the NOWPayments API.
Using the NOWPayments API allows you to integrate crypto payment processing with your store seamlessly.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for a more advanced digital store setup, consider deploying the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. This setup provides enhanced features and support for businesses that require a more robust infrastructure. You can also check out our products page at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more information on our sovereign infrastructure solutions.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a digital store on Cloudflare Pages for free, follow these steps: create a GitHub account and set up a new repository for your store, install the Cloudflare Pages CLI on your computer and set up a new project, create a NOWPayments account and obtain your API key, set up a Cloudflare Worker to handle orders and trigger the delivery of your digital products, use the NOWPayments API to integrate crypto payment processing with your store, deploy your store on Cloudflare Pages using the Cloudflare Pages CLI, test your payment processing setup by making a test purchase, and finally, go live and start selling your digital products.

Stack 01 is a basic infrastructure setup that includes GitHub Pages, a Cloudflare Worker, and NOWPayments, while Stack 02 is a more advanced setup that includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. Stack 02 provides enhanced features and support for businesses that require a more robust infrastructure.

You can build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free using our sovereign infrastructure setup, which includes Cloudflare Pages, a Cloudflare Worker, and NOWPayments. Follow the steps outlined in this guide to deploy your store and configure your payment processing pipeline.
Can I use GitHub Pages instead of Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, you can use GitHub Pages instead of Cloudflare Pages, but keep in mind that GitHub Pages has some limitations compared to Cloudflare Pages. For example, GitHub Pages does not support serverless functions or real-time updates, while Cloudflare Pages does. Consider using Cloudflare Pages for a more scalable and customizable infrastructure setup.
